purpose: Reads out one selected experiment subject: its lifecycle, and its readout against the control on every arm and basis, rollup section, and element.
data: Per experiment subject, one lifecycle row and the experiment-analysis readout rows: per arm and basis the sessions, assigned share, sample-ratio p-value, conversion, revenue per session, and lift with p-value; per arm the section capture; per rollup section and arm the seen and click rates; per element and arm the click rate and clicker conversion. Daily rows are in ae_experiment_row.
